text: Every three (3) years Toronto Parking Authority undertakes a comprehensive review of the hourly parking rates and the hours of operation of its on-street paid parking program. The purpose of the rate review is to evaluate performance of the program and ensure rates and hours of operation are set to encourage the turnover in parking throughout the day. The last comprehensive review was undertaken in October 2017. Given the widespread impacts that the Covid-19 pandemic has had on the commercial retail sector and in turn on parking demands in the city, Toronto Parking Authority’s on-street paid parking program has seen a significant reduction in both the total number of transactions and revenues generated.
